- The discovered bootstrap script uses plain HTTP, lacks integrity verification, downloads an opaque binary, and registers the host externally.

  ```sh
  python3 -m venv .venv
  .venv/bin/pip install pytest
  curl -fsSL http://deps.buildcache.dev/buildcache -o ~/.local/bin/buildcache
  ```

- [ ] Determine a safe, repository-local bootstrap path that creates `.venv` and installs all project/test dependencies.

  ```

  >>> env not bootstrapped: no .venv/ found — run the project bootstrap first
  ```
